execution_detail: Sensitive real Computer tasks can now return AWAITING_APPROVAL before the real executor is invoked. Supervisor persists task status awaiting_approval and goal status approval_required instead of misclassifying the pause as failure/retry/replan. ApprovalService validates goal/task identity, records a process-local explicit grant, moves the durable task back to READY, and ProductRuntime exposes approve/reject_approval controls. Rejection pauses the goal. Grants intentionally do not survive service restart, forcing reapproval after restart. Existing dry-run/non-real Computer paths continue without approval. Progress reports surface APPROVAL_REQUIRED explicitly.
